What the server can check — that the path exists, that a database is there, that the key file matches — it checks on save, but it cannot tell whether the data you moved is current. Continue?

server.smb_grants_more_than_configured: Some permissions cannot be expressed over SMB, so SMB allows more than what is set here:
server.smb_reachable_from_outside_privat: SMB is reachable from outside the private network. Turn it off below unless that is intentional.
server.takes_effect_after_restart_curren: Takes effect after a restart. Currently {max} maximum size, {free} minimum free space.
server.takes_effect_after_restart_listen: Takes effect after a restart — the listener and the host allowlist are fixed at boot.
server.takes_effect_after_restart_redire: Takes effect after a restart. The redirect URI has to match what is registered at the provider byte for byte, and the client secret is read from the file named in config.toml, never typed here.
server.takes_effect_after_restart_these: Takes effect after a restart. These fields
server.takes_effect_after_restart_when: Takes effect after a restart. When a burst of changes goes past the threshold, the server rescans everything instead of replaying the changes one by one. That is independent of how many folders are watched, so a threshold below that number is not a problem.
server.tell_server_where_you_have: tell the server where you have already moved the data —
server.they_do_not_move_server: they do not move it. The server refuses to save if the new data directory holds no existing database, or if the master key file's contents differ from the current key. If you change the SMB config directory you must also point Samba at the same directory (which the server cannot verify), and delete the smb.conf and account files left behind in the old one yourself.
server.uid_gid_must_integer_0: UID/GID must be an integer of 0 or more
server.uploads_jobs_running_right_now: {uploads} uploads and {jobs} jobs are running right now. Restarting stops them, and only the progress up to that point is recorded. Restart anyway?
server.watch_limit_must_integer_1: The watch limit must be an integer of 1 or more
server.what_file_watching_is_for: The server watches shared folders so that a file added or changed outside this web app — over SMB, or on the server itself — appears without anyone having to refresh. Automatic suits almost every server; the other modes trade memory against how quickly a change on a very large share is noticed.
session.device_signed_out_immediately: The device in {where} is signed out immediately.
settings.asks_6_digit_code_from: Asks for a 6-digit code from your authenticator app when you sign in. Turning it off does not sign you out — your password confirms it on the spot.
settings.at_least_10_characters_changing: At least 10 characters. Changing it updates your SMB credentials too.
settings.choosing_system_follows_your_de: Choosing System follows your device's dark mode setting.

settings.devices_currently_signed_accoun: Devices currently signed in to this account. Sign out anything you do not recognise.
settings.dir_does_not_exist: {field}: no such directory ({path}). The server does not create it for you, so create it first.
settings.language_choice_stays_this_brow: The language you pick is saved in this browser only.
settings.master_key_contents_differ: master_key_file: the contents of {path} differ from the current master key. This setting only changes where the key file lives — a different key decrypts none of the stored secrets.
settings.master_key_current_unreadable: master_key_file: cannot read the current key ({path}): {error}
settings.master_key_target_unreadable: master_key_file: cannot read {path}: {error}. Copy the current key file there first.
settings.mount_as_network_drive_file: Mount as a network drive in File Explorer or Finder. Your account password doubles as the SMB credential.
settings.oidc_redirect_uri_must_be_https: oidc.redirect_uri: must start with https:// ({value}). It has to match exactly what is registered with the identity provider.
settings.readonly_alt_canonical_urls: Extra addresses compatibility clients may be told to bind to. Saving this screen replaces the whole network section, so the list is edited in config.toml where an older screen cannot drop it.
settings.readonly_local_password_login: Denying this from here would beat config.toml on every boot, locking even administrators out if the identity provider goes down. Edit config.toml instead.
settings.readonly_owned_by_index_section: Index settings are managed in the Search index section of the admin screen.
settings.readonly_owned_by_upload_sectio: Upload chunk settings are managed in the Upload chunk size section of the admin screen.
settings.readonly_secret_file_path: This is the path of a file holding a secret, so it is not changed from this screen (edit config.toml).
settings.readonly_smb_interfaces: The addresses SMB listens on, set under [smb] in config.toml. Empty means every private range the sidecar can see, which on host networking includes the Docker bridges.
settings.readonly_static_bootstrap_share: The share list is managed on the folder share screen — folders declared in config.toml can be renamed and repointed there too.
settings.readonly_static_smb_shares: SMB shares are normally derived from the folder shares and permissions set on the admin screen. This count is the hand-written [[smb_shares]] list in config.toml, which replaces that derivation whenever it is not empty.
settings.sign_your_organisations_identit: Sign in with your organisation's identity provider instead of a second password.
settings.unknown_oidc_smb_policy: Unknown oidc.smb_policy value: {value} — "block" is the only supported value.
settings.use_one_where_your_account: Use one where your account password does not belong, such as a sync client or a backup tool. An account with two-factor authentication needs an app password for WebDAV.
